Add it to a `ggplot` with `+`. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Apply the survival theme to a Kaplan-Meier plot: ::: {#936d2dc2 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import greenwood as gw # Load data and fit a stratified Kaplan-Meier estimator lung = gw.load_dataset("lung", backend="polars") km = gw.KaplanMeier().fit("Surv(time, status) ~ sex", data=lung) # Apply the survival theme to the plot gw.plot_survival(km, backend="plotnine") + gw.theme_survival() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ![](theme_survival_files/figure-html/cell-2-output-1.png){width=672 height=480} ::: :::
